 Software Development Engineer
 Job ID: 10586770 | Amazon.com Services LLC
 Apply now 
 Description
 The SPB Agent platform is the AI reasoning layer behind Amazon Ads — powering agentic experiences that autonomously guide millions of advertisers, sellers, and sales teams with personalized, data-backed intelligence across the Ads Console, Seller Central, and Next Gen Selling. You'll design and deliver generative AI systems that reason over campaign performance, make autonomous decisions on behalf of sellers, and deliver hyper-personalized advertising guidance at massive scale.
Experiences powered by the platform include AI Campaign Overview (a dynamic widget that adapts its narrative in real time based on performance data), AI Companion for Selling Partners (a personalized assistant that provides guidance and executes actions on behalf of sellers), and AI for Sales Teams (an intelligent copilot grounded in each advertiser's objectives and guardrails). You'll work at the intersection of large language models, distributed systems, and advertising — collaborating with AI researchers and engineers to shape how businesses connect with customers through AI.
What Makes This Role Stand Out
- The AI is the product — you're not adding AI to an existing tool; you're building the reasoning platform that powers multiple agentic products across Amazon Ads
- Ships to millions — advertisers, sellers, and sales teams worldwide interact with the experiences your platform powers
- Frontier AI stack — LLMs, agent-based architectures, autonomous decision-making, real-time personalization at massive scale
- Greenfield agentic architecture — designing how AI agents reason, act, and explain themselves in an advertising context
Key job responsibilities
- Design and develop the SPB Agent platform — a secure, reusable, low-latency architecture that integrates generative AI/ML technologies to deliver consistent, well-reasoned advertiser guidance across multiple products
- Deliver features end to end across the agentic AI stack, from LLM integration and prompt engineering to distributed serving infrastructure and real-time personalization
- Optimize operational costs at scale through efficient resource utilization, token consumption management, and memory footprint reduction
- Collaborate with AI researchers, scientists, and cross-functional teams to integrate AI-driven solutions across the Ads Console, Seller Central, and sales tools
- Build scalable systems that process millions of data points to deliver hyper-personalized advertising experiences with low latency
- Develop new approaches to conversational AI and natural language interactions in advertising contexts, translating research into production-quality features
- Mentor peers through design reviews and code reviews, contributing to engineering quality as the platform scales
About the team
The Sponsored Products and Brands team at Amazon Ads is re-imagining the advertising landscape through generative AI technologies, revolutionizing how millions of customers discover products and engage with brands across Amazon.com and beyond. We are at the forefront of re-inventing advertising experiences, bridging human creativity with artificial intelligence to transform every aspect of the advertising lifecycle from ad creation and optimization to performance analysis and customer insights. We are a passionate group of innovators dedicated to developing responsible and intelligent AI technologies that balance the needs of advertisers, enhance the shopping experience, and strengthen the marketplace. If you're energized by solving complex challenges and pushing the boundaries of what's possible with AI, join us in shaping the future of advertising. 
The SPB Agent team builds and operates the agentic AI platform behind multiple advertiser-facing and seller-facing AI experiences across Amazon Ads. We work closely with AI researchers and engineers to push the boundaries of what autonomous, personalized advertising guidance can look like at Amazon scale.
 Basic Qualifications
 - 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language
 Preferred Qualifications
 - 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
